text: 带精灵沿深圳五站散步，拖动地图可以看看前方的风景。首次进入旅途可直接连接 Apple 健康，或点一次阅读打卡。留意每日首项习惯结算的原因与贝壳数，去小铺买一盆簕杜鹃，再把它摆到喜欢的位置。也欢迎和朋友试试小队接力。专注计时满 15 分钟会获得经验，锁屏后暂停。

Walk the five Shenzhen districts with your pet. Connect Apple Health on the journey screen or log a reading session. Check your first daily reward, visit the shop, and place a bougainvillea planter along the route. Try a squad relay with a friend. A 15-minute focus session earns experience and pauses when the phone locks.
